blob_region — BLOB extract op

• Data kinds: labels2d → mask

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.blob_region(labels: 'Any', index: 'int') -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import blob2d; blob2d.blob_region(labels: 'Any', index: 'int') -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsblob.get("blob_region"))

Usage

Extracts 1 object as a binary region (bool). index is 1-based.

A selection op that just returns labels == index. The numbers are the consecutive 1..n that blob_label assigned, and 0 is the background.

• labels: 2-D integer label image (output of blob_label / blob_select / blob_split). bool masks are rejected (to prevent the accident of "measuring several objects as 1", it prompts you to apply blob_label first). float is also rejected (it cannot decide which object 0.999 is). Negative numbers raise ValueError.

• index: an int with 1 <= index <= labels.max(). 0 (background) or out of range raises ValueError. Same numbering as the label column of blob_features and the result of blob_select_largest (renumbered from 1).

• Returns: bool of shape (H, W). It is never empty (the number always exists -- however, a home-made label image with gaps that was not renumbered by blob_select can return all False).

The extracted region can be passed directly to blob_distance (distance transform), the blob_overlay overlay, or the contour drawing of annotate_outline.
